title: Calibration Report
description: VERIFY-stage harness artifact (absorption wave 1; AAAI-26 pilot + SPECS-lite pattern). Output of tools/review_calibration.py: known errors are seeded per criterion into a fixture paper, the review panel runs blind, and this report scores the panel's planted-error recall. The FIRST external ground truth for the machine's reviewer prompts — a regression test for every persona/model change. EVIDENCE only: a low recall flags prompts for revision, it never auto-rewrites anything.

fixture_ref.description: The seeded fixture document (under tests/ or runs/ scratch — never the vault original).

by.description: Which reviewer seat caught it (persona label / openreviewer seat).

review_ref.description: The review artifact where the catch appears.

recall_by_criterion.description: criterion -> planted-error recall for that criterion.

leniency_anchor.description: Optional mean-score offset vs the human-calibrated anchor seat (OpenReviewer leniency-bias anchor).
